newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian overnight, one-week rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian overnight, one-week rates fall.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Wednesday in a liquid private-sector market to a range of 8-3/4 to 9-7/8 percent, against a range of 9-7/8 to 10-1/8 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
There was little one-week lending but one banker quoted 9-3/4 to 9-7/8 percent, compared with around 10-1/16 on Tuesday.
The market is usually most liquid on Wednesdays and Thursdays, the last two days of the Egyptian working week.
